description: Weather for any point on Earth by latitude and longitude: current temperature in Celsius, conditions (clear, cloudy, rain, snow), precipitation in mm, wind speed and direction, humidity, cloud cover and air pressure, plus an hourly forecast for up to 48 hours. Data from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute. Use for travel and event planning, logistics, agriculture and any agent that needs the weather. Costs $0.002 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

hours.description: Hours of hourly forecast to return, 1-48 (default 12)

name: weather
